# Criteo
> Criteo is a commerce media company providing advertising, retail media, measurement, and monetization solutions for brands, retailers, agencies, and publishers.

Criteo’s website spans corporate information, product overviews, developer resources, retail media capabilities, publisher monetization, careers, and company insights. This llms.txt emphasizes durable, high-signal pages that help language models understand Criteo’s platform, solutions, and technical ecosystem.

## Company
- [About Criteo](https://www.criteo.com/about-us/): Overview of Criteo’s business, mission, and role in commerce media.
- [Leadership](https://www.criteo.com/about-us/leadership/): Executive leadership team and company management information.
- [Careers](https://www.criteo.com/careers/): Job opportunities, culture, and working at Criteo.
- [Newsroom](https://www.criteo.com/news/): Company announcements, press releases, and media resources.
- [Investor Relations](https://www.criteo.com/investors/): Financial reports, governance, and investor information.
- [Contact Us](https://www.criteo.com/contact/): Contact options for sales, support, and general inquiries.

## Solutions
- [Commerce Media Platform](https://www.criteo.com/commerce-media-platform/): Overview of Criteo’s platform for advertising, retail media, and measurement.
- [For Brands](https://www.criteo.com/solutions/brands/): Solutions for brands to reach shoppers and drive commerce outcomes.
- [For Retailers](https://www.criteo.com/solutions/retailers/): Retail media and monetization solutions for retailers and marketplaces.
- [For Agencies](https://www.criteo.com/solutions/agencies/): Agency-focused tools and services for campaign execution and performance.
- [For Publishers](https://www.criteo.com/solutions/publishers/): Monetization and audience solutions for media owners and publishers.
- [Commerce Growth](https://www.criteo.com/solutions/commerce-growth/): Performance advertising solutions focused on customer acquisition and sales.

## Retail Media
- [Retail Media](https://www.criteo.com/solutions/retailers/retail-media/): Retail media capabilities for onsite and offsite advertising monetization.
- [Sponsored Products](https://www.criteo.com/solutions/retailers/sponsored-products/): Native retail ad formats that promote products within retailer environments.
- [Display Advertising](https://www.criteo.com/solutions/retailers/display-advertising/): Display ad solutions for retailer inventory and shopper engagement.
- [Offsite Ads](https://www.criteo.com/solutions/retailers/offsite-ads/): Extend retailer audiences beyond owned properties with offsite media activation.
- [Retail Media Measurement](https://www.criteo.com/solutions/retailers/measurement/): Measurement and reporting for retail media performance and sales impact.

## Brand Advertising
- [Commerce Max](https://www.criteo.com/solutions/brands/commerce-max/): AI-driven campaign solution for maximizing commerce outcomes across channels.
- [Retail Media Demand](https://www.criteo.com/solutions/brands/retail-media/): Access retailer media inventory to reach shoppers near purchase.
- [Commerce Display](https://www.criteo.com/solutions/brands/commerce-display/): Display advertising designed to drive consideration and conversion.
- [Commerce Video](https://www.criteo.com/solutions/brands/commerce-video/): Video advertising formats for upper- and mid-funnel commerce campaigns.
- [Audience Targeting](https://www.criteo.com/solutions/brands/audience-targeting/): Shopper audience targeting based on commerce signals and intent data.

## Publisher Monetization
- [Publisher Solutions](https://www.criteo.com/solutions/publishers/): Overview of monetization products and demand access for publishers.
- [Commerce Grid](https://www.criteo.com/solutions/publishers/commerce-grid/): Supply-side technology and demand connections for media monetization.
- [Retail Media for Publishers](https://www.criteo.com/solutions/publishers/retail-media/): Publisher participation in commerce and retail media ecosystems.
- [Yield Optimization](https://www.criteo.com/solutions/publishers/yield-optimization/): Tools and services to improve revenue and inventory performance.
- [Identity and Addressability](https://www.criteo.com/solutions/publishers/addressability/): Addressability solutions for privacy-aware audience activation and monetization.

- [Marketing Solutions API](https://developers.criteo.com/marketing-solutions/reference): Reference documentation for campaign and audience management APIs.
- [Retail Media API Reference](https://developers.criteo.com/retail-media/reference): Endpoint reference for retail media operations and reporting.
- [Authentication](https://developers.criteo.com/marketing-solutions/docs/authorization): Authorization and authentication guidance for API access.
